sections.heading: One journal for care and growth
body: Task Journal brings completed tasks and progress photos together. Open it from Home, or choose Task Journal in a plant’s menu to see that plant only. It replaces the old Plant Journal window; Home still shows pending tasks.

sections.heading: Completed tasks
body: Task tiles keep their type, plant and location. The completion column shows Completed, the date and the person who completed the task on three rows. Notes are always visible when present. Owners can edit the linked reminder or delete the task entry; Plant details opens the plant.

sections.heading: Adding a photo
body: Add photo is the first action in the + menu. Choose a plant you own, take a photo or select one from your gallery, and optionally add a photo date and notes. Adjust the framing and save. Journal photos are separate entries and do not replace the plant’s main photo.

sections.heading: One photo every seven days
body: You can create one photo entry per plant every seven days (168 hours), counted from the server’s upload time. Changing its photo date, editing or deleting it does not restart this interval. The form shows when the next photo can be added.

sections.heading: Photo tiles and editing
body: Photo tiles appear among completed tasks, with a fading image, Added and its timestamp at the top right, and notes at the bottom. They have no task-type badge. Tap a tile for Edit photo, Plant details or Delete photo. Owners can replace the image, change the optional date or notes, and delete after confirmation.

sections.heading: Sorting and filtering
body: Sort by entry date, plant name or location. Filter by plant, location, type or entry date range; choose Photo to show only photos. A photo’s entry date is when it was added, while its optional photo date is shown separately.

sections.heading: Task export and bulk deletion
body: Export tasks emails a spreadsheet of your tasks using the current task filters; pending tasks can be included. Delete tasks removes completed tasks matching the chosen criteria. Both actions are owner-only and exclude photos, even in a mixed journal. Delete photos individually from their tile menu.

sections.heading: Private photos and shared plants
body: Photos are resized and stored privately on the server. Only the owner and people with active sharing access to that plant can view them. Recipients can view the journal but cannot add, edit or delete its photos. Replaced and deleted photos are cleaned up; deleting a plant removes its journal photos too.
